findings.observation: Onboarding permits an empty mother stage and saves baby information. The legacy mother-profile select has only pregnancy-preparation/pregnancy/postpartum values; empty state has no selected option, so HTML defaults to the first option. Submitting this form sets the stage to pregnancy-preparation and unconditionally clears birth, birthWeeks and the entire babies array for any non-postpartum stage.
findings.reproduction: Complete onboarding as mother with stage omitted and baby data; open My > Mother profile, change only current concern (or save directly); save. The form defaults to pregnancy-preparation and clears previously saved baby data.
findings.impact: Optional-stage semantics are lost and an unrelated profile edit can erase multiple babies' information.
findings.fix: Add an explicit empty/choose-later option and preserve the existing stage when not changed; do not erase stored baby records as a side effect of stage editing. Prefer one shared profile editor/model.
findings.confidence: Code-confirmed and observed_runtime by /root: omitted-stage onboarding > old mother profile defaults to pregnancy-preparation > save unchanged > birthday becomes empty. Reviewer inspected screenshots 07 and 08; screenshot 08 confirms changed visible profile context, while actual data clearing is supported by operator observation and source code.

findings.location: assets/app.js:12,102,153,301; PAGE-onboarding > birth versus PAGE-mine > baby-profile
findings.observation: Onboarding birthday accepts dates through the actual current day via profileToday(), while the legacy baby profile sets max to fixed demo DAY=2026-10-19 and makes birthday required.
findings.reproduction: Enter 2026-10-20 birth date during onboarding; open My > Baby profile and try to save an unrelated baby-name edit. The same previously accepted birth date violates the legacy max and native form validation blocks submit.
findings.impact: Valid onboarding data cannot be saved in the second editor. An omitted birthday also becomes required when editing only the baby name.
findings.fix: Use the same current-date upper bound and optionality in both editors; share birthday validation. Keep fixed demonstration time only for the record simulation.
findings.confidence: Code-confirmed and observed_runtime by /root; reviewer independently inspected screenshot 06 showing 2026/10/20 input and native validation requiring no later than 2026/10/19.

HOME-0.1 is explicitly a historical candidate and is invalid for this guard's baseline naming contract; no receipt is present. Guard therefore does not establish current completeness or certification.
findings.impact: Current behavior cannot be audited as a complete approved frozen package or handed off as full requirement/flow/state coverage. This does not invalidate the user's explicit authorization of the latest changes or the usefulness of the candidate preview.
findings.fix: Create a current candidate requirements delta and ledger with current pages, controls, actions, states and executable tests. Preserve historical sources; obtain approval of the actual candidate before creating a new legal baseline. Do not rename or fabricate an old approval simply to pass guard.
